```{r}
fig_dir_E3 <- "Figures/Fig6/"

save_fig_E3 <- function(name, width = 7, height = 5, device = grDevices::pdf, bg = "white", dpi = 300) {
  # Ensure directory exists
  if (!dir.exists(fig_dir_E3)) dir.create(fig_dir_E3, recursive = TRUE)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_dir_E3, name),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    dpi = dpi,
    device = device
  )
}

save_chordDiagram_E3 <- function(link_counts, cell_colors,
                                 file_name, width = 10, height = 10, file_type = "pdf") {
  if (!dir.exists(fig_dir_E3)) dir.create(fig_dir_E3, recursive = TRUE)
  file_path <- file.path(fig_dir_E3, file_name)
  circos.clear()

  if (file_type == "pdf") {
    grDevices::pdf(file_path, width = width, height = height)
  } else if (file_type == "png") {
    grDevices::png(file_path, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 300)
  } else {
    stop("file_type must be 'pdf' or 'png'")
  }

  circlize::chordDiagram(
    x = link_counts,
    grid.col = cell_colors,
    transparency = 0.3,
    directional = FALSE,
    big.gap = 30
  )
  grDevices::dev.off()
  message("Chord diagram saved to: ", normalizePath(file_path))
}
```

```{r}
Cluster_Highlight_Plot(
  seurat_object    = E16_barcodes_E3,
  cluster_name     = 'Neural Crest',
  highlight_color  = "gold",
  background_color = "lightgray",
  pt.size          = 0.5,
  reduction        = "umap.harmony"
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = c( -11, 6.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = c(-5, 6), linetype = "dashed", color = "black")
```

```{r}
umap_coords <- Embeddings(E16_barcodes_E3, reduction = "umap.harmony")
cell_clusters <- Idents(E16_barcodes_E3)
umap_coords_cluster1 <- umap_coords[cell_clusters == "Neural Crest", ]

x_min <- -11
x_max <- 6.5
y_min <- -5
y_max <- 6

# Find cells inside the box (within cluster 1 only)
cells_in_box_cluster1 <- rownames(umap_coords_cluster1[
  umap_coords_cluster1[, 1] >= x_min &
  umap_coords_cluster1[, 1] <= x_max &
  umap_coords_cluster1[, 2] >= y_min &
  umap_coords_cluster1[, 2] <= y_max, 
])

# Find cells outside the box (within cluster 1)
cells_outside_box_cluster1 <- setdiff(rownames(umap_coords_cluster1), cells_in_box_cluster1)
length(cells_outside_box_cluster1) #50 cells
```

```{r}
cells_outside_box_cluster1 <- as.character(cells_outside_box_cluster1)
#Cleanup
E16_barcodes_subset <- subset(E16_barcodes_E3, cells = cells_outside_box_cluster1, invert = TRUE)
```

```{r}
E1 <- readRDS("Data/E16_barcodes_E1.rds")
E2 <- readRDS("Data/E16_barcodes_E2.rds")
if (!"major_cell_type_3" %in% colnames(E1@meta.data) || !"major_cell_type_3" %in% colnames(E2@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "E1/E2 objects lack 'major_cell_type_3'. Run Expt1_Processing.Rmd and ",
    "Expt2_Processing.Rmd first (or use annotated objects from GEO)."
  )
}

#Regardless of CloneID or not
prop_E16_barcodes_E1 <- E1@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::count(major_cell_type_3) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

prop_E16_barcodes_E2 <- E2@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::count(major_cell_type_3) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

prop_E16_barcodes_E3 <- E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::count(major_cell_type_3) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n))


prop_E16_barcodes_E1$dataset <- "Experiment 1"
prop_E16_barcodes_E2$dataset <- "Experiment 2"
prop_E16_barcodes_E3$dataset <- "Experiment 3"
comp <- bind_rows(prop_E16_barcodes_E1, prop_E16_barcodes_E2,prop_E16_barcodes_E3)
celltype_order <- unique(comp$major_cell_type_3)

comp$major_cell_type_3 <- factor(
  comp$major_cell_type_3,
  levels = celltype_order
)

comp$dataset <- factor(
  comp$dataset,
  levels = c("Experiment 1", "Experiment 2", "Experiment 3")
)

germ_layer_cols <- c(
  "Mesodermal" = "#FFD700",
  "Neural Crest" = "#6a0dad",
  "Endodermal" = "#FF69B4"
)

ggplot(comp, aes(x = dataset, y = prop, fill = major_cell_type_3)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.65, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.12),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = germ_layer_cols) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of cells", x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

```{r,fig.height = 4, fig.width = 5, fig.align = "center"}
alluvial_df_fixed <- comp %>%
  select(major_cell_type_3, dataset, prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = dataset,
    values_from = prop,
    values_fill = 0
  )

alluvial_long <- alluvial_df_fixed %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Experiment 1", "Experiment 2","Experiment 3"),
    names_to = "dataset",
    values_to = "value"
  )

cols_links <- c(
  "Mesodermal" = "#FFD700",  
  "Neural Crest" = "#6a0dad",  
  "Endodermal" = "#FF69B4"   
)

ggplot(
  alluvial_long,
  aes(
    x = dataset,
    stratum = major_cell_type_3,
    alluvium = major_cell_type_3,
    y = value
  )
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = major_cell_type_3),
    width = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = major_cell_type_3),
    width = 0.3, 
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_links) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Experiment 1", "Experiment 2", "Experiment 3")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of cells", x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
save_fig_E3("E1E2E3_comparision_majortypes.pdf", width = 5, height = 4) # Supplemmentary
```

```{r}
# Exporting cellIDs for TREX analysis
ids_E3 <- rownames(E16_barcodes_subset_4@meta.data)
head(ids_E3)
ids_E3 <- gsub("-1$", "", ids_E3)
head(ids_E3)
indexed_ids_E3 <- data.frame(
  index = seq(0, length(ids_E3) - 1),
  cell_id = ids_E3
)

write.table(
  indexed_ids_E3,
  file = "Data/cellids_E3.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
```

```{r}
#Find differentially expressed genes
Idents(E16_barcodes_E3) <- E16_barcodes_E3$assigned_cell_type

markers_E3_subtypes <- FindAllMarkers(

  min.pct = 0.50,
  logfc.threshold = 1,
  test.use = "wilcox"
)

markers_E3_subtypes_to_export <- markers_E3_subtypes %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 1) %>%
  mutate(pct_diff = pct.1 - pct.2) %>%
  select(cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj, everything()) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))

# Save
write.csv(markers_E3_subtypes_to_export,file = file.path(fig_dir_E3, "E16_E3_subtypes_markers.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
write.xlsx(

  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

```{r,fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10, fig.align = "center"}
length(singleton_clones_E3) # 1634 clones
```

```{r}
# First, count total clones per major cell type
total_clones_per_type_E3 <- E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type) %>%
  filter(clone_type != "No CloneID") %>%
  summarise(total_clones = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop")

# Count singleton clones per major cell type
num_singleton_clones_E3 <- E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% singleton_clones_E3) %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type) %>%
  summarise(n_singleton = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop")

# Count single-type clones per major cell type
num_single_type_clones_E3 <- E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% single_type_clones_E3) %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type) %>%
  summarise(n_single_type = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop")

# Count multi-type clones per major cell type
num_multi_type_clones_E3 <- E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% multi_type_clones_E3) %>%
  group_by(major_cell_type) %>%
  summarise(n_multi_type = n_distinct(clone_nr), .groups = "drop")

# Combine all counts
clone_counts_E3 <- total_clones_per_type_E3 %>%
  left_join(num_singleton_clones_E3, by = "major_cell_type") %>%
  left_join(num_single_type_clones_E3, by = "major_cell_type") %>%
  left_join(num_multi_type_clones_E3, by = "major_cell_type") %>%
  # Replace NA with 0 for cell types with no clones in that category
  mutate(
    n_singleton = replace_na(n_singleton, 0),
    n_single_type = replace_na(n_single_type, 0),
    n_multi_type = replace_na(n_multi_type, 0)
  ) %>%
  # Calculate percentages within each major_cell_type_4
  mutate(
    pct_singleton = n_singleton / total_clones * 100,
    pct_single_type = n_single_type / total_clones * 100,
    pct_multi_type = n_multi_type / total_clones * 100
  )

# View the results
clone_counts_E3
```

```{r}
# Prepare for the Upset Plot For E3
clone_metadata_E3 <- E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(clone_nr)) # remove NA

clone_counts_E3 <- as.data.frame(table(clone_metadata_E3$clone_nr))
colnames(clone_counts_E3) <- c("clone_nr", "cell_count")
shared_clones_E3 <- clone_counts_E3 %>%
  filter(cell_count > 1) # only leaving multicellular clones

shared_clone_metadata_E3 <- clone_metadata_E3 %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% shared_clones_E3$clone_nr)

clone_analysis_E3 <- shared_clone_metadata_E3 %>%
  dplyr::select(clone_nr, major_cell_type_3)

data_wide_E3 <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(clone_analysis_E3$clone_nr, clone_analysis_E3$major_cell_type_3))
celltype_E3 <- colnames(data_wide_E3)
set_sizes_E3 <- colSums(data_wide_E3)

# Compute total number of cells per clone (sum across all cell types)
clone_sizes_E3 <- rowSums(data_wide_E3)

# Convert to binary for UpSet intersections
binary_matrix_E3 <- data_wide_E3 %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(. > 0, 1, 0))) # Convert non-zero values to 1
binary_matrix_E3$Clone_Size <- clone_sizes_E3
sets_vec_E3 <- colnames(binary_matrix_E3)[-ncol(binary_matrix_E3)]
```

```{r}
  summarise(
    types = list(unique(major_cell_type_3)),
    n_types = n_distinct(major_cell_type_3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_types >= 2) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pairs = list(combn(types, 2, simplify = FALSE))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(pairs) %>%
  mutate(
    from = sapply(pairs, `[`, 1),  # extract first element of each pair
    to   = sapply(pairs, `[`, 2),  # extract second element
    value = 1                       # each clone counts as 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(from, to) %>%            # now count clones per pair
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop")

self_links_E3 <- clone_links_E3 %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(
    types = list(unique(major_cell_type_3)), 
    n_types = n_distinct(major_cell_type_3),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_types == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = sapply(types, `[`, 1),  # extract from list
    value = 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%                # count clones per cell type
  summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(from = cell_type, to = cell_type) %>%
  select(from, to, value)

pairwise_links_all_E3 <- bind_rows(clone_pairs_E3, self_links_E3) 
pairwise_links_all_E3 <- pairwise_links_all_E3 %>% dplyr::select(from, to, value)

sectors <- unique(c(pairwise_links_all_E3$from, pairwise_links_all_E3$to))
grid.col <- cols_links[sectors]

pdf(file.path(fig_dir_E3, "chorddigram_clonebased_E3.pdf"), width = 3, height = 3)
circos.clear()
chordDiagram(
  pairwise_links_all_E3,
  grid.col = grid.col,
  transparency = 0.4 
) 
dev.off()
```

```{r,fig.height = 6, fig.width = 10, fig.align = "center"}
clone_cols <- c(
  "No CloneID" = "grey70",
  "Singleton" = "grey70",
  "Region not shared at all" = "#56B4E9",
  "Region shared by stomach, jej_ileum" = "#006D2C",
  "Region shared by stomach, colon" = "#006D2C",
  "Region shared by jej_ileum, colon" = "#006D2C",
  "Region shared by stomach, jej_ile, colon" = "#D81B60"
)

clone_region_map_E3 <- E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(
    regions = list(sort(unique(sample))),
    clone_type = dplyr::first(as.character(clone_type)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shared_clone_category = case_when(
      clone_type == "No CloneID" ~ "No CloneID",
      clone_type == "Singleton" ~ "Singleton",
      TRUE ~ map_chr(regions, function(r) {
        if (length(r) == 1) {
          "Region not shared at all"
        } else if (all(c("E16_stomach", "E16_jej_ileum") %in% r) && length(r) == 2) {
          "Region shared by stomach, jej_ileum"
        } else if (all(c("E16_stomach", "E16_colon") %in% r) && length(r) == 2) {
          "Region shared by stomach, colon"
        } else if (all(c("E16_jej_ileum", "E16_colon") %in% r) && length(r) == 2) {
          "Region shared by jej_ileum, colon"
        } else if (all(c("E16_stomach", "E16_jej_ileum", "E16_colon") %in% r) && length(r) == 3) {
          "Region shared by stomach, jej_ile, colon"
        } else {
          stop(paste("Unexpected region combination:", paste(r, collapse = ", ")))
        }
      })
    )
  )

E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data$shared_clone_category <-
  clone_region_map_E3$shared_clone_category[
    match(E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data$clone_nr, clone_region_map_E3$clone_nr)
  ]

E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data$shared_clone_category <- factor(
  E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data$shared_clone_category,
  levels = c(
    "No CloneID",
    "Singleton",
    "Region not shared at all",
    "Region shared by stomach, jej_ileum",
    "Region shared by stomach, colon",
    "Region shared by jej_ileum, colon",
    "Region shared by stomach, jej_ile, colon"
  )
)

table(E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data$shared_clone_category)
E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data$shared_clone_category <- factor(
  E16_barcodes_E3@meta.data$shared_clone_category,
  levels = names(clone_cols)
)

DimPlot(E16_barcodes_E3, group.by = "shared_clone_category", reduction = "umap.harmony", pt.size = 0.5, order = T, cols = clone_cols)  + ggtitle(NULL) + xlab("UMAP1") + ylab("UMAP2")
save_fig_E3("umap_E3_regional_sharedclones_includingcrossgermlayers.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
```

```{r,fig.height = 9, fig.width = 6, fig.align = "center"}
# Prepare metadata with relabeled ENS subtypes
ens_meta_shared <- E16_E3_ENS@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(clone_nr))

ens_shared_metadata <- ens_meta_shared %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  summarise(
    samples = paste(
      unique(sample[order(match(sample, c("E16_stomach", "E16_jej_ileum", "E16_colon")))]),
      collapse = " / "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Build clone x subtype proportion matrix
heatmap_matrix_ens <- ens_meta_shared %>%
  group_by(clone_nr, major_cell_type_2) %>%
  tally(name = "cell_count") %>%
  group_by(clone_nr) %>%
  mutate(prop = cell_count / sum(cell_count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(clone_nr, major_cell_type_2, prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = clone_nr,
    names_from = major_cell_type_2,
    values_from = prop,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("clone_nr") %>%
  as.matrix()

# 4. Align row annotation
row_data_ens <- ens_shared_metadata %>%
  filter(clone_nr %in% rownames(heatmap_matrix_ens)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("clone_nr")

row_data_ens <- row_data_ens[rownames(heatmap_matrix_ens), , drop = FALSE]

# 5. Region annotation colors
all_unique_combos <- unique(row_data_ens$samples)
ens_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(all_unique_combos)), all_unique_combos)

ra_ens <- rowAnnotation(
  region = row_data_ens$samples,
  col = list(region = ens_colors),
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    region = list(
      title = "Regions",
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )
)

# 6. Order subtype columns
subtype_order <- c(
  "ENS Progenitor",
  "ENS Neuroblast",
  "ENS Branch A",
  "ENS Branch B",
  "SCP"
)

existing_cols <- intersect(subtype_order, colnames(heatmap_matrix_ens))
heatmap_matrix_ens <- heatmap_matrix_ens[, existing_cols, drop = FALSE]

# 7. Order region groups

region_order <- c(
  "E16_stomach / E16_jej_ileum / E16_colon",
  "E16_stomach / E16_colon",
  "E16_stomach / E16_jej_ileum",
  "E16_jej_ileum / E16_colon",
  "E16_stomach",
  "E16_jej_ileum",
  "E16_colon"
)

region_colors <- c(
  "E16_stomach / E16_jej_ileum / E16_colon" = "#E41A1C",  
  "E16_stomach / E16_colon" = "#FF69B4",      
  "E16_stomach / E16_jej_ileum" = "#FF7F00",              
  "E16_jej_ileum / E16_colon" = "#41AB5D",
  "E16_stomach" = "#8C6D31",
  "E16_jej_ileum" ="#FDBF6F",
  "E16_colon" = "#CAB2D6"
)

  
row_data_ens$samples <- factor(row_data_ens$samples, levels = region_order)

# reorder rows to match split order
ord <- order(row_data_ens$samples)
heatmap_matrix_ens <- heatmap_matrix_ens[ord, , drop = FALSE]
row_data_ens <- row_data_ens[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# rebuild annotation AFTER ordering rows
ra_ens <- rowAnnotation(
  region = row_data_ens$samples,
  col = list(region = region_colors),
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    region = list(
      title = "Regions",
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )
)

# 8. Continuous color scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "#6baed6", "#08306B"))

pdf(file.path(fig_dir_E3, "ENS_E3_subtype_sharing_heatmap_subtype_allclones.pdf"), width = 6, height = 9)

Heatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_ens,
  name = "Proportion",
  right_annotation = ra_ens,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  row_split = row_data_ens$samples,
  row_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  border = TRUE,
  column_names_side = "top",
  column_title = "Long-Distance ENS Migrants: Regional & Subtype Composition",
  row_title = "Shared CloneIDs"
)

dev.off()
```
